version: deployed cloud.firestore release; Firestore REST v1 (firestore.googleapis.com)
method: S7-R, 2026-10-24: the cloud.firestore release of chatapp-8ae21 pointed for about a minute, three times, at its own rules plus one block, match /aruma-ref/{run}/{rest=**}, whose allow statements are each guarded by rest[0] (the rulesets below are that block alone: the rest of the deployed source matches no aruma-ref path). Requests: Firestore REST v1 get and createDocument on aruma-ref/s7r-20261024/<probe>/<doc>; a missing document answers 404 when allowed and 403 when denied. Run 1 with the ID token of a temporary anonymous user whose customAttributes were set through identitytoolkit accounts:update (auth below: the claims the probes read, numbers as the JWT payload wrote them); runs 2 and 3 without a token. Read fixtures were written with the owner's credentials (outside rules): run 1 by createDocument, runs 2 and 3 by commit. Raw requests and answers: raw/deployed-firestore.json.
orderNote: values() order on deployed Firestore is the backend map's, not the source's nor the keys': on a REST createDocument it changed between identical requests; on a read it is the stored document's, which followed the write for documents written by commit and did not for documents written by createDocument
